decision: Use Go standard library and offline mocks; no weight downloads.
ICE is syntax-derived and hash-validated. Explicit interface assertions are compiler-checked; call/test maps are syntactic candidates, not semantic coverage.
No shell or file writes. Rooted read tool requires exact caller allowlists.
One in-memory worker, at most 256 retained results; no durable queue or implicit recovery.
Only deterministic fixture failure enables bounded repair. Final acceptance always external_required.
Lifecycle is a transition model. A separate operator-configured modelhost now supervises one pinned CPU-only llama-server experiment; no plane runtime authority is granted.
Numeric loopback HTTP only, no proxies, redirects or credentials. Endpoint health must list the configured model.
Small-model benchmarks retain strict raw-format failures. Process/SSE success does not imply model correctness. Native Windows validation requires actual execution, not cross-compilation.
